film.caption: 42 seconds. Six suspects.
film.description: Actual native synthesis and ink, rendered as six studio sound studies. This is not headset footage or a spatial-audio demonstration. No microphone input or user recordings are used.

modules.name: Almost Asleep
modules.soundDescription: Almost Asleep: A soft sustained chord slowly brightens and shimmers.

modules.name: Small Doubts
modules.soundDescription: Small Doubts: Clear, bell-like notes rise and fall in a repeating pattern. The pulse gradually quickens.

modules.name: Below Thought
modules.soundDescription: Below Thought: Rounded low notes form a repeating bass line, with a brighter edge as the phrase develops.

modules.name: Insistent Thought
modules.soundDescription: Insistent Thought: Short, pitched taps step through a pattern. The pulses gradually quicken.

modules.name: Someone Else
modules.soundDescription: Someone Else: A hollow, choir-like chord slowly breathes and gently beats as it opens in brightness.

modules.name: An Old Feeling
modules.soundDescription: An Old Feeling: A warm, reed-like chord drifts with slow wow, fine flutter, and faint tape hiss.

provenance: Native synthesis engines and synchronized PixelCanvas artwork. Offline studio studies; not headset footage or a spatial-audio demonstration.
